data.name: Asaafun
data.gender_notes: Asaafun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Asaafun is derived from the Arabic word 'as-saff' which means 'rows of plants'. It symbolizes the growth and expansion of new life. It also conveys a sense of joy and happiness. The name Asaafun carries the meaning “Growth, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Asaafun usually hope their child will grow to embody growth, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asaafun is a name that reminds us of the beauty and wonder of creation. It encourages us to cultivate our inner gardens and nurture our spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Asaafun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Growth, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asaafun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hindi.name: आसाफ़ुन
in_hindi.meaning: आसाफ़ुन नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति लेखन या गणना कार्य करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसाफ़ुन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों को संदर्भित करता है जो लेखन या गणना कार्य में विशेषज्ञ होते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इस नाम को परंपरागत और महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, क्योंकि यह नाम उन विद्वानों और कातिबों को याद दिलाता है जिन्होंने इस्लामी सभ्यता में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया है।

in_english.name: Asaafun
in_english.meaning: Asaafun means one who performs calculations or writes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asaafun is derived from the Arabic root 'asf', which means to calculate or write. In Islamic tradition, this name has been associated with individuals who were skilled in arithmetic, writing, or record-keeping. Historically, it was used for scribes and accountants who played crucial roles in early Islamic society. The name Asaafun symbolizes knowledge, precision, and the ability to document and manage information accurately.
